items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Somebody told me, by the way, that Clarence Jones, as if he was something special. Was he very good? Clarence Jones? Jones, yes. [INTERVIEWEE] A piano player?

ctx.x: But he didn't figure then. He figured he was the best piano player there was in the world, but after they left the piano, he just figured he was...

Who were considered the very best in Chicago then? He was. I mean, otherwise, were there other people... Somebody told me, by the way, that Clarence Jones, as if he was something special. Was he very good? Clarence Jones? Jones, yes.
